Symptoms like dizziness, headache, irritability and fatigue are typical, and may require avoidance of repeated head injury, a gradual return to activity and rest, and requirements to avoid working memory and concentration-intensive tasks. Most people make a full recovery with appropriate rest and care, but may experience chronic symptoms relating to mental processing and memory. Anyone with a concussion or head injury requiring hospitalization should seek immediate medical care, and PTSD-like symptoms and Post-Concussion Syndrome may require additional medical attention and time to resolve. All patients should receive supportive care from friends and loved ones, and adequate rest and sleep, and should be closely monitored by a physician to detect and address potential post-injury complications like emotional issues, fatigue and delayed healing.
